title: Francis Stupey Log Cabin Museum

services.name: Log Cabin
services.desc: Highland Park’s oldest standing structure is located in Laurel Park between the library and city hall. The cabin, built in 1847, was given to the people of Highland Park as a Centennial gift in 1968 by Exmoor Country Club.
